title: Shopify checkout discounts multiplied across shipping lines
evidence: The merged diff changes the abandoned-checkout discount model to sum shipping prices by checkout_id and source_relation before joining. Previously each shipping line could replicate the same discount contribution before the report grouped by discount code and type.
adaptation: Replays the changed join at the pre-aggregation grain and materializes the new shipping rollup in fixture setup. The checkout details join and final report aggregation are omitted, so counts measure contributions to the aggregate.
before_sql:
SELECT d.id, d.amount, s.price
FROM abandoned_checkout_discount_code AS d LEFT JOIN abandoned_checkout_shipping_line AS s
ON s.checkout_id = d.checkout_id AND s.source_relation = d.source_relation
after_sql:
SELECT d.id, d.amount, s.price
FROM abandoned_checkout_discount_code AS d LEFT JOIN roll_up_shipping_line AS s
ON s.checkout_id = d.checkout_id AND s.source_relation = d.source_relation
